svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Blog data model
svg.desc: Blog data model. 6 components. Connections: users to posts (writes); posts to comments (has); members to comments (writes); posts to posts_tags (filed as); tags to posts_tags (files).

text.tspan: The core of Ghost's schema: staff write posts, members comment, tags file posts
